yarj.build.gpsCorrectionMenuDesc: Analyze spatio-temporal speed to fix cross-region outlier drifts
yarj.build.recomputeGuessesDesc: Statically interpolate missing coordinates between neighbors
yarj.build.gpsCorrectionSubtitle: Analyze spatio-temporal speed plausibility to correct anomalous outliers
yarj.build.algoDescContent: Photos are arranged chronologically. Speeds are calculated from great-circle displacements over elapsed time. If momentary speed exceeds realistic limits (e.g. drifting to another country), outliers are identified and smoothed via time interpolation. Corrections are written to a dedicated field without overwriting original records.

yarj.build.minDriftHint: Only correct jumps exceeding this distance to avoid misidentifying local intra-city movements
